spl_product_data_elements: YAT TIP TOR SALICYLIC ACID LANOLIN PARAFFIN PETROLATUM SALICYLIC ACID SALICYLIC ACID
indications_and_usage: Uses For the removal of corns and calluses Relieves pain by removing corns and calluses
warnings: Warnings For external use only Allergy alert: This product contains natural rubber latex which may cause allergic reactions
do_not_use: Do not use on irritated skin on any area that is infected or reddened if you are a diabetic if you have poor blood circulation
ask_doctor: Stop use and ask a doctor or podiatrist if discomfort persists nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, or skin rash occurs
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact an Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions wash affected area and dry thoroughly apply medicated plaster over corn or callus after 48 hours remove the medicated plaster repeat this procedure every 48 hours as needed for up to 14 days (until corn/callus is removed)
storage_and_handling: Other Information store at 15∞ to 30 C (59 to 86 F), away from heat
